_note: COMPLETE NHS Trac application form map, extracted from a real 8-page Trac application export (Norfolk & Suffolk NHS FT, Clinical Administrator, 2026-09-15). Trac is ONE system across NHS trusts, so this map is reusable everywhere Trac is used. 'fill' = how the Trac handler answers each field: 'profile' (from the user's saved details), 'ai' (generate/choose via question_ai / cv tailoring), 'user_confirm' (SENSITIVE — must be the user's own true answer, never auto-guessed), 'auto' (safe default). Repeater sections say max rows. The data controller is the trust; the ATS is Civica Trac.

sections.note: THE KEY VALUE. A tailored personal statement showing how the applicant meets the essential/desirable criteria in the person spec — reasons for applying, strengths, what sets them apart. Generated from the JD/person-spec + the user's CV, same engine as cv tailoring / cover letter. Do NOT duplicate info from other sections.
Mix of value/behaviour screeners and post-specific yes/no. Sensitive dismissal questions must be the user's true answer (user_confirm).
